lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey, Yamcha!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Thanks for coming by and picking up the rest of your stuff.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey, no problem!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: I mean... didn't have to, y'know... throw out most of it...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Eh, you were dead and it was taking up space.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Much like your corpse.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Ha ha! Ah... where did you bury me anyway?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Bury?
Flies buzzing

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: So, Bulma, how's the single life treating you?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: It's been nice actually, had a dream about Vegeta last night--

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: You slut!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: We were walking in a park!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: You slut!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: OK, first off, we're not even dating!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Second of all, I don't even like him.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Third, he's probably running out of fuel soon, so God knows if he'll ever make it back here.
BOOM

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'M BACK, BITCHES!

lines.speaker: Panchy
lines.text: Sweetie, roll out the cot! I think we have a visitor!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Is he colored?!

lines.speaker: Panchy
lines.text: I'm not sure, I never open my eyes!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey, you've got a lot of nerve coming back here!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh, a valet. Neat. I'm not tipping.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Don't you remember who I am?! We fought when you landed on Earth!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: No, I fought Kakarot. *Nappa* fought everyone else.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, except for that one scrub who got killed by a Saiba--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Hahaha! Ahahahahaha! AHAHAHAHAhahaha!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Oh, yeah?! I dare you to come over here and laugh at me!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Ha... ha... ha.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Yeah, see, now we can laugh together?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: OK, seriously, we have enough to clean up without a pool of Yamcha's urine.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: You, come with me.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Because you need a shower! I could smell you from East City.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Grumbling)... Pacific Ci-- smell you from East City... (grumbling)

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: 'Yeah, you better run...'

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey, I'm setting out some new clothes for you, and I'm gonna wash your armor!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Fine, but be careful! Those are dry clean only!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Whatever.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: No, seriously, they lose their elasticity!
Door shuts

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: ...Hello?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So... Vegeta's living here now?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: That's neat.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: The man single-handedly responsible for murdering most of the entire gang is taking a shower in the other room.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: "Neat" is not the first word that comes to mind.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: OK, so I just got a look at Vegeta's ass, and besides being surprisingly nice, he's got this weird hole.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Uh, yeah, even boys have those, Bulma.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: No, you idiot! I mean a hole *above* that one!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: ...You mean he's a chick??

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Earth-woman! Where's the cleansing powder?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: We don't have that here, we have soap!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: The hell is "soap"?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: It's that yellow block there made of animal fat!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: That sounds *awesome*!
CHOMP

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Blah! This tastes nothing like what you just said!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: OK, I change my mind, this *is* pretty neat.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Is that the beta male?!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: No! Krillin just got here!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh *God*, they're *breeding*!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I swear, the only thing I hate more than weaklings, is the color pink!
Sounds of Vegeta getting out of the shower

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: There it is...

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: The home of the brute who dared lay hands on my darling little angel.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Yes, Daddy.

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: What a pretty little blue pearl it is.

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: What was it called? "Ee-arth"?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Actually, it's pronounced "Earth", Daddy-Daddy-Daddy-Daddy.
BZZZT

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: Really? But there's an "A" in it.

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: I'm just going to keep calling it Ee-arth.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: It doesn't really matter anyway. Soon, it'll have a brand new name...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: *Vacant Lot*!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Son of a BITCH!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: What, still ticked off about the shirt?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: No, I'm-- well, yes actually, I'm absolutely livid. But that's not the point!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: That idiot Kakarot *failed*! Freeza's *still alive*!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Chiaotzu... do you feel that?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: There are two enormous power levels approaching the planet.

lines.speaker: Chiaotzu
lines.text: Yeah, see, last time this happened... I blew myself up.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Yeah, I was gonna ask you to hold off on that this time.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: RAAAAAAAAAaargh!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'See, now we just have to carve out an area and then we'll start building the hi--eyyy, do you feel that?'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Freeza?! NOOOOOOOOOooooo!!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'OK, I'm right here! Please stop yelling!'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh God, Gohan! It's him it's him it's him it's him it's him it's him it's him it's him it's him it's him it's him it's him!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin, calm down! Now are you sure it's him?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Gohan, once you've had a man inside of you... you know when he's coming.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Mom! Where's my Saiyan suit?!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Woman! Where is my Saiyan suit?!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: It's under your bed!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: It's in the wash!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You bitch!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Alright, judging by how quickly his power level is closing in, he should be here in about--

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey, so I need to talk to you about Bulma!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You cannot be serious!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Look, we're not dating anymore, but still, she's a really close friend and--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You are actually doing this right now.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey, guys!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh, great! And she's here too!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Why don't all you idiots just start showing up?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey, Vegeta!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I was f*cking *kidding*!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Tenshinhan! Chiaotzu!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Huh, looks like we got here in time.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Oh hey... Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Nice shirt.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And there it is!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Now all we need is the Namekian and we'll have the whole potpourri of pathetic.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Uh, been here the whole time, actually.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh, what do you want? A medal?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...Nice shirt.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Kiss my ass, green man.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah, it's the kind of shirt that really screams--

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: HUH...!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: HE'S COMING!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: He's landing over there!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Wait, now he's pulling back.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: No, now he's-- Going back that way...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: What's he doing?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Daddy, we can park anywhere we want!

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: Now, son, if this is anything like that jockstrap incident, we don't want to get boxed in.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So has anyone else noticed that there are *two* power levels around the same strength on that ship?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yeah, it's probably his dad.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: He has a father?!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Makes sense. Everyone has a dad.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...'Ceeept me.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Ha! Your dad's dead!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So's yours!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: HA!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So, essentially, we have two opponents of equal strength that my father could only beat after fulfilling an ancient alien prophecy.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Does anyone in particular know exactly what we're doing here besides trying not to lose it?!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Guys, we are so screwed! I don't know what we're gonna do! I mean this is completely crazy! Why did I come here again?! We're going to die!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: I'm gonna die again! I don't wanna die again! Dying once is bad enough! Oh go-ha-hah!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You know, if he weren't doing it... I would.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: We don't need Kakarot or anyone else.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You have enough badass Saiyan on your team as it is.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Now if you'll excuse me, you all can just sit on your hands while I go up there and take care of business.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Or - maybe we could hide our power levels, sneak closer to them, survey the situation from up close, and, perhaps, catch them by surprise?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Y'all are bitches.

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: Well, son, is this what you were expecting?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: My God, this is droll.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: We're so far out in the space sti-ti-ti-ticks, there's not even a space Radioshack, much less a space Best Buy-Buy-Buy-Buy--
BZZZT

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Circuit City.

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: Are you alright?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Yes, Daddy, just processing.

lines.speaker: King Cold
lines.text: And wouldn't you know it, no place to buy more RAM!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: But I won't lie, Daddy. I'm absolutely ecstatic.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: When that filthy monkey arrives back on the planet, he'll return not to the smiling faces of his dear friends and family...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: but a Total. Unadulterated. *Genocide*!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Speaking of which... Soldiers! The scavenger hunt will proceed as such:

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: * Normal human heads are worth one point. * Namekian heads are worth twenty. * Filthy half-Saiyan brats, fifty!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: And if you find any miserable, odious, insubordinate, full-blooded monkey garbage...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: you win!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, off you go!

lines.speaker: Mooks
lines.text: Yes, sir!

lines.speaker: Mook
lines.text: So... how many points are those?
♫ Closing theme (DBZ intermission) ♫

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Oh my God guys, I don't know what we're gonna do here, I- I mean I can't do anything! This is completely insane! I- ike- I'm talking completely, and totally, out of your mind insane! I mean look at thi- look at those guys! I mean I can't see them but I can know they're there! And that's bad enough! I-I-do-Oh-ger- there it goes, there goes my pants- I can't believe! My pants are-- moist now! I mea- no, no no, I'm a man, I'm a ma- OH GOD I'M NOT A MAN ANYMORE WHAT DOES IT MATTER IF I'M A MAN- A WOMAN- A MONKEY! Ehuh! I'm talking nonsense right now...
